ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels. The dark pigmentation is concentrated in the central and basal regions, while high-intensity pixels are dominant on the distal lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, contiguous low-intensity dark blob occupies the central fluke area from the peduncle to the notch. The distal lobes exhibit high-intensity white backgrounds overlaid with irregular low-intensity linear streaks and focal mottling along the mid-to-outer regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 50 degrees and a well-defined vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) of 5 to 15 pixels relative to the mean edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep along the lateral distal edges, transitioning to a moderately concave curvature toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, high-contrast brownish-white pixel clusters (indicative of barnacle colonization) are concentrated specifically at the extreme lateral apices of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (consistent with tooth rake marks) are distributed across the high-intensity white portions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustations present at both distal tips; irregular serration pattern suggests cumulative minor physical trauma along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent set of nearly parallel, vertical dark linear marks is visible on the inner-white portion of the right lobe.
